snippet.title: Kopno: Blightfall - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Enter a dark fantasy open-world survival RPG where your choices shape the world around you.

Explore a vast world across the surface and underground, build your settlement, recruit companions, master unique skills, and fight your way through a world filled with dangerous creatures, ancient mysteries, and powerful factions.

Choose your race. Forge your path. Decide the fate of those you encounter.

Welcome to Kopno.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4498500/Kopno_Blightfall/
